Main.ListLabel: Chapter list (optional): the page of the site that lists all the chapters
Main.FileName: File name (optional; empty = page title; numbered when there are several addresses; with a volume it is the volume name):
Main.FolderPicker: Folder where the files are saved
Main.ShowBrowser: Show the browser (if the site blocks or asks for a check)
Main.Reader: Page through the reader (if the site shows one page at a time and it is not detected automatically)
Main.ParallelTip: Faster with page-by-page readers: while one chapter waits for the page to change, the others keep going. The first chapter is downloaded on its own (so any anti-bot check happens only once), then the others together. If a site starts blocking or giving errors, lower the number.
Main.ChapterTip: Empty = taken from the chapter list or from the page title. With several addresses it goes up by 1 for each one.
Main.VolumeTip: Volume title "Series Vol. 02". Empty = "Series 001-010", from the chapters it contains.
Main.SingleVolume: Create a single volume (all the chapters in the addresses in one file)
Main.ConvertTip: Turns the .cbz files you already have in a folder into EPUB, without downloading anything
Series.LanguageTip: Language of the comic (2-letter code): used by ebook readers and by the volume's table of contents.
Series.KoboTip: Tick it if you read on a Kobo. Same EPUB, but with the .kepub.epub extension: the Kobo opens it with its own reader, which shows comic pages better. Other ebook readers don't recognize it.
Convert.Title: Convert CBZ to EPUB
Convert.Restored: Series details restored from the EPUBs already created in this folder.
Convert.ChooseFolder: First choose a folder with some .cbz files.
Convert.Duplicate: Number {0} is used by more than one chapter: fix it before continuing.
Convert.CopyHint: Copy them to your ebook reader connected via USB (a subfolder is fine too).
Log.ListMissing: First paste the address of the page with the chapter list.
Log.RangeInvalid: "{0}" and "{1}" must be chapter numbers (or empty).
Log.ListNone: No chapters recognized on this page: paste the chapter addresses by hand.
Log.ListFound: Found {0} chapters in the list (from {1} to {2}).
Log.ListNoneInRange: No chapters in the chosen range: check "{0}" and "{1}".
Log.ListInserted: Added {0} chapters to "Addresses" (from {1} to {2}): check them, then press "{3}".
Log.AntiBotRetry: I've already ticked "{0}": press "{1}" again to retry.
Log.SeriesRequired: The series name is required to create EPUBs.
Log.Parallel: Downloading up to {0} chapters at a time (the first one on its own).
Log.VolumeNoChapters: No chapters downloaded: volume not created.
Volume.MissingOne: 1 chapter out of {0} was not downloaded
Volume.MissingMany: {0} chapters out of {1} were not downloaded
Engine.WebKitDownload: Downloading WebKit (first launch only, it may take a few minutes)...
Engine.Scrolling: Scrolling the page to load all the images...
Engine.NoImages: No images found (try a lower minimum side or show the browser).
Engine.NotAvailable: Found a single landscape image: the chapter is probably not available (yet).
Engine.Retry: The site didn't respond as expected: retrying (attempt {0} of {1})...
Engine.AntiBot: Anti-bot protection found on {0}: tick "{1}" and try again. If a check appears in the window, complete it yourself and the download will continue on its own.
Engine.CheckWaiting: The site is asking for a security check: complete it in the browser window (waiting up to 3 minutes)...
Engine.CheckTimeout: Security check not completed within 3 minutes.
Engine.ReaderProbe: Checking whether it is a page-by-page reader...
Engine.ReaderEnd: End of chapter: the page no longer changes.
Engine.ReaderLoop: End of chapter: the reader went back to a page already seen ({0}).
Engine.ReaderStuck: I can't turn the page in this reader.
Engine.Blocked: Blocked {0} attempts to open ads or other pages.
